cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on the Microsoft 18 Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎觀看這支使用 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 教學影片。

cues.en: Today we're going to look into Foundry Local, which just came out as 1.0, meaning general availability.
cues.zh: 今天要介紹 Foundry Local，它剛推出 1.0，也就是正式可用版本。

cues.en: So before we jump into code, let's talk a little about what it is and its history.
cues.zh: 在開始看程式碼之前，先談談它是什麼，以及發展歷程。

cues.en: Because this is Microsoft's own definition, Foundry Local is an end-to-end local AI solution, blah, blah, blah.
cues.zh: Microsoft 的官方定義是：Foundry Local 是一套端到端的本機 AI 解決方案，等等。

cues.en: It's about being able to run LLMs locally.
cues.zh: 簡單來說，就是讓你在本機執行 LLM。

cues.en: And using some SDKs, we are, of course, using the C-Sharp version.
cues.zh: 它提供一些 SDK，我們當然會使用 C# 版本。

cues.en: The alternative to Foundry Local is OLama, which can run the OLama models, but also a lot of other models.
cues.zh: Foundry Local 的另一個選擇是 Ollama，可以執行 Llama 模型，也支援很多其他模型。

cues.en: But I think, as far as this goes, Microsoft put out Foundry Local in order to satisfy enterprise businesses
cues.zh: 不過我認為 Microsoft 推出 Foundry Local，主要是為了滿足企業需求，

cues.en: that can't really just be dependent on an open-source model like OLama, which is not owned by Meta.
cues.zh: 因為企業不一定能完全依賴 Ollama 這類開放原始碼專案，而 Ollama 本身也不是由 Meta 維護。

cues.en: So let's talk a little history about this, because I have actually covered Foundry Local before, but it has been a very bumpy ride on what this is.
cues.zh: 接著談談發展歷程。我其實以前介紹過 Foundry Local，但這項產品一路走來相當顛簸。

cues.en: It was introduced back in May 2025 at the Build Conference from Microsoft, and in June, the first version came out, and that was version 0.1,
cues.zh: 它在 2025 年 5 月的 Microsoft Build 大會上首次亮相，6 月推出第一個版本，也就是 0.1，

cues.en: because we were in preview mode at that time.
cues.zh: 因為當時還在預覽階段。

cues.en: So quickly, we got over June, August, September, we got version 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3.
cues.zh: 之後在 6 月、8 月與 9 月，陸續推出 0.1、0.2 與 0.3。

cues.en: It required to be downloaded using Winget before we could work, but that was pretty okay to work with, but it was a little odd that you actually needed to download some
cues.zh: 使用前必須先透過 WinGet 下載。操作上還算可以，但必須先在電腦上下載某些元件，

cues.en: to your machine before it worked.
cues.zh: 功能才會運作，這點有點奇怪。

cues.en: That might be good for a local machine, but if you want to run it up in a cloud or something, that should be very annoying that you can't make the code do it all.
cues.zh: 在本機開發可能還好，但如果想放到雲端執行，不能讓程式自動完成所有設定，就會很麻煩。

cues.en: So in my samples back then, I actually automated Winget in order to get it to work.
cues.zh: 所以當時我的範例，其實有自動執行 WinGet，讓整個流程能運作。

cues.en: So I was okay with it at that point.
cues.zh: 當時我覺得還能接受。

cues.en: I'm not really a big fan of offline models, but it worked, and it could connect at that time to the semantic kernel,
cues.zh: 雖然我不算很喜歡離線模型，但它確實能用，而且當時也能連接 Semantic Kernel，

cues.en: which was the predecessor to the ADIN framework.
cues.zh: 也就是 Agent Framework 的前身。

cues.en: Then in November 2025, something very, very odd happened.
cues.zh: 接著在 2025 年 11 月，發生一件非常奇怪的事。

cues.en: Something very, very odd happened.
cues.zh: 真的非常奇怪。

cues.en: They released, suddenly went from 0.3 to a version 0.8.0.1, and 0.8.0.2.
This was a complete rewrite of what we have seen in the early days.
cues.zh: 這是一次完全重寫，與早期版本截然不同。

cues.en: Winget was gone, and it was made with some open-source NuGet package
cues.zh: 不再使用 WinGet，而是採用某個開放原始碼 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: that was not the official OpenAI standard,
cues.zh: 但那不是官方 OpenAI 標準套件，

cues.en: but something it felt totally randomly picked off, and it made it completely incompatible with everything else Microsoft did.
cues.zh: 而是感覺像隨意選來的東西，導致它和 Microsoft 其他相關產品完全不相容。

cues.en: So when I saw this and tried it out and tried to make it work again, I simply gave up and went back to 0.3 because I knew that worked.
cues.zh: 所以我看到後實際測試，試著讓它重新運作，最後直接放棄，退回確定能用的 0.3。

cues.en: And since then, they must have come to their senses because now in April 2026, we have version 1.0.
cues.zh: 之後他們似乎終於想通了，因為現在是 2026 年 4 月，我們有了 1.0。

cues.en: And again, it's not dependent on Winget, and it has compatibility with ADIN framework, as we'll see in some code in one second.
cues.zh: 同樣不再依賴 WinGet，而且也相容 Agent Framework，稍後就會看到程式碼。

cues.en: But let's also evaluate a bit if it's worth doing because there is some oddnesses in it still,
cues.zh: 不過也值得評估一下是否真的值得使用，因為目前還有一些奇怪之處，

cues.en: but that's perhaps to be expected from local.
cues.zh: 也許本機模型本來就會遇到這些情況。

cues.en: But let's have a look at the code.
cues.zh: 接著看程式碼。

cues.en: So here I have the code.
cues.zh: 這裡就是程式碼。

cues.en: It's in 0 to 1st agent under OpenAI-based because it's still OpenAI-based, and 0 to 1st agent local foundry.
cues.zh: 放在 Zero to First Agent 的 OpenAI Based 底下，因為它仍然以 OpenAI 相容介面為基礎，範例名稱是 Local Foundry。

cues.en: So let me get rid of this.
cues.zh: 先把這個關掉。

cues.en: So the model I'm going to use is a very, very small model, GWEN3, 0.6 billion parameters.
cues.zh: 這次會使用非常小的模型 Qwen3，參數量只有 0.6B，也就是六億。

cues.en: And that's because my graphics card is very, very small.
cues.zh: 因為我的顯示卡效能很有限。

cues.en: And for that reason, I can also only use the CPU models, not the GPU or NPU models in here.
cues.zh: 因此這裡也只能使用 CPU 模型，無法使用 GPU 或 NPU 模型。

cues.en: So I'm just going to use Direct4CPU, but you can change here and also go up to higher models.
cues.zh: 所以先設定為直接使用 CPU，但你可以修改，也可以選用更大的模型。

cues.en: What models are available, we will see in one second.
cues.zh: 稍後會看到目前有哪些模型可用。

cues.en: One thing to note is that in order to use this, you either need to use a foundry-local WinNL or a foundry-local on other types of machines.
cues.zh: 要注意，依機器類型不同，需要使用 Foundry Local 的 WinML 套件，或是其他平台適用的 Foundry Local 套件。

cues.en: So you need conditional NuGet package in here to do this, and also you need conditional target frameworking that you need to target the windows before they work,
cues.zh: 因此這裡需要條件式 NuGet 套件參考，也要依條件指定 Target Framework，Windows 版本必須明確以 Windows 為目標，

cues.en: not just the normal .NET 10.
cues.zh: 不能只設定一般的 .NET 10。

cues.en: So already here, it's a bit funky, but it is doable.
cues.zh: 這部分已經有點奇怪，但確實做得到。

cues.en: So if we do this, we make a folder where we can store all these things.
cues.zh: 接著建立一個資料夾，存放這些內容。

cues.en: In my case, I would put it in my user folder here, and you can see it's empty at the moment.
cues.zh: 這個例子放在使用者資料夾中，可以看到目前是空的。

cues.en: So we're going to make what is called a foundry-local manager, and we're going to make it with a name and a path
cues.zh: 我們會建立 FoundryLocalManager，提供名稱、路徑，

cues.en: and where we want to host the models in terms of a local web server.
cues.zh: 以及要用本機 Web 伺服器在哪個位置提供模型服務。

cues.en: So we're going to do that, and once it's created, we can take its instance.
cues.zh: 建立完成後，就能取得它的 Instance。

cues.en: Again, a little funky way of doing things, but it is possible.
cues.zh: 同樣地，做法有點特殊，不過可以使用。

cues.en: Then we're going to get a catalog of models, and then we can list these models.
cues.zh: 接著取得模型目錄，並列出這些模型。

cues.en: And let me run it down here so we can see.
cues.zh: 先執行到這裡看看。

cues.en: These are the models that are supported, and among them there is this Quintree 1.6 billion.
cues.zh: 這些就是支援的模型，其中有剛剛提到的 Qwen3 0.6B。

cues.en: So it's not everything in the world that can be used.
cues.zh: 因此並不是世界上所有模型都能使用。

cues.en: The biggest and most interesting one is GPT-OSS 20 billion parameters,
cues.zh: 其中最大、也最有意思的是 GPT-OSS 20B，具有兩百億個參數，

cues.en: which is the OpenAI ChatGPT open source model that was released that are roughly equivalent to, I think,
cues.zh: 也就是 OpenAI 推出的開放模型。我認為能力大約介於，

cues.en: between ChatGPT 4.0 and ChatGPT 5.0.
cues.zh: ChatGPT 4.0 與 ChatGPT 5.0 之間。

cues.en: It's a little stronger than 4.0 and not as smart as 5.0.
cues.zh: 比 4.0 強一些，但沒有 5.0 那麼聰明。

cues.en: So it's a fairly okay model, but there's also all the FHIR models, the Quint models, and the Whisper models, if need be.
cues.zh: 所以算是不錯的模型。另外也有 Phi、Qwen，以及需要時可使用的 Whisper 模型。

cues.en: So once we have these, we can get the specific model, and we give this alias.
cues.zh: 取得目錄後，就能透過這個別名，選擇特定模型。

cues.en: And in there we need to find among… In this case there's only one variant that is CPU-bound,
cues.zh: 接著要在不同變體中選擇。這個例子只有一個 CPU 版本，

cues.en: but there could have been a GPU-bound version of some of them, and then you would be able to choose the model of…
cues.zh: 但某些模型也可能有 GPU 版本，這時就可以選擇，

cues.en: if it should use GPU, CPU, or NPU.
cues.zh: 要用 GPU、CPU 或 NPU。

cues.en: In our case we do that, and then we check if it's already in the cache, meaning have it already been downloaded.
cues.zh: 選好之後，檢查是否已經在快取中，也就是之前是否已經下載過。

cues.en: And by now we don't have any models downloaded, so there won't be any, and we'll go in and download.
cues.zh: 目前沒有下載任何模型，因此快取裡不會有，接著就會下載。

cues.en: This will take a little while, not too much, it's not a big model.
cues.zh: 這需要等一下，但不會太久，因為模型不大。

cues.en: This one has a progress download, which is broken at the moment, so don't use it.
cues.zh: 這裡有下載進度回報功能，但目前壞掉了，所以不要使用。

cues.en: It will download, but you can't really show the process, it has a bug.
cues.zh: 模型仍會下載，只是無法正常顯示進度，這部分有錯誤。

cues.en: So it's a rough 1.0 in my opinion.
cues.zh: 所以在我看來，這個 1.0 還相當粗糙。

cues.en: But we now have our model downloaded, so we can see in here that we got a 511 megabyte big model here.
cues.zh: 現在模型下載完成，可以看到這裡有一個 511 MB 的模型。

cues.en: So behind the scenes it's our next models.
cues.zh: 背後使用的是 ONNX 模型。

cues.en: So let's load the model into memory.
cues.zh: 接著把模型載入記憶體。

cues.en: And again, on the bigger models this will take longer, but here it was only 500 megabytes we needed to load in, and it's CPU bound, so it's taking up my memory and my CPU.
cues.zh: 較大的模型會花更久，但這裡只有約 500 MB，而且使用 CPU，因此會占用系統記憶體與 CPU。

cues.en: And then we're going to start a small web server that we set up here, so we have a local URL to do this.
cues.zh: 接著啟動前面設定的小型 Web 伺服器，讓我們可以透過本機 URL 使用。

cues.en: So now we have the Outry part up and running, it now runs a mini web server that we can connect to these models,
cues.zh: 現在 Foundry 部分已經啟動，執行一個小型 Web 伺服器，讓我們連接這些模型，

cues.en: similar to when you do OLAMA and just start the OLAMA service.
cues.zh: 和使用 Ollama 時啟動 Ollama 服務很類似。

cues.en: And you can, of course, wrap this into any kind of service you want in order to run these models.
cues.zh: 當然，也可以包成任何需要的服務來執行模型。

cues.en: In this case we are just running it in a console app where we first both run the server and consumes it, but in real life you will, of course, have two different processes.
cues.zh: 這個例子在同一個主控台程式中，同時啟動伺服器並呼叫它；實際上通常會使用兩個不同程序。

cues.en: Then we go in and make, based on our service URL, which we have here,
cues.zh: 接著根據這裡的服務 URL，建立用戶端。

cues.en: so we can see it gave us on the fly a port.
cues.zh: 可以看到它即時分配了一個連接埠。

cues.en: Up here we didn't specify it, but it will on the fly serve a port.
cues.zh: 前面沒有指定，所以會在執行時自動選擇連接埠。

cues.en: And then we're going to make a normal OpenAI client, but instead of an API key, because it's local, we don't need one, so we can just write anything here. In my case I wrote no API key.
cues.zh: 然後建立一般 OpenAIClient。不過因為在本機執行，不需要 API 金鑰，所以這裡隨便填即可；我填的是 no API key。

cues.en: And then we need to pass the endpoint in.
cues.zh: 另外也要傳入端點。

cues.en: And once we do this, we have everything like normal.
cues.zh: 完成後，其他操作就和平常一樣。

cues.en: We can do a chat client and we can get an AI agent like normal.
cues.zh: 可以取得 ChatClient，再像平常一樣建立 AI 代理程式。

cues.en: And then we can begin to ask our questions.
cues.zh: 接著開始提出問題。

cues.en: So first question is, what's the capital of Sweden?
cues.zh: 第一個問題是：瑞典的首都是哪裡？

cues.en: And it will come back using normal agent framework.
cues.zh: 它會透過一般的 Agent Framework 回傳結果。

cues.en: And come back and hopefully say something here.
cues.zh: 接著應該就會回答。

cues.en: Oh, so it's also showing it's thinking.
cues.zh: 喔，它也把思考內容顯示出來了。

cues.en: Apparently that's the way that model works.
cues.zh: 看來這個模型就是這樣運作。

cues.en: Strange, but different models, different way of doing things.
cues.zh: 有點奇怪，但不同模型本來就有不同做法。

cues.en: But it come back at least and say the capital of Sweden is Stockholm. That's okay.
cues.zh: 不過至少最後回答瑞典首都是斯德哥爾摩，這是正確的。

cues.en: And then we can do the same in streaming.
cues.zh: 也可以用串流做同樣的事情。

cues.en: I will just set a breakpoint down here and let it stream on how to make soup.
cues.zh: 在下面加上中斷點，讓它串流回答如何煮湯。

cues.en: First it will give us back the thinking part.
cues.zh: 首先會回傳思考部分。

cues.en: Again, it's not all models that just does this.
cues.zh: 同樣地，不是每個模型都會直接這樣輸出。

cues.en: So we don't need to take it away in real life.
cues.zh: 因此實際應用中，不一定都需要自行移除思考內容。

cues.en: So in this case it was how to make tomato soup and it will show us that.
cues.zh: 這次詢問如何製作番茄湯，它會顯示做法。

cues.en: And then we can stop the web service and we can unload the model from memory so we can free up our memory.
cues.zh: 最後可以停止 Web 服務，並把模型從記憶體卸載，釋放記憶體。

cues.en: And then we're done.
cues.zh: 這樣就完成了。

cues.en: So this is completely different from what you have seen previously from my videos because, again, it's complete rewrite.
cues.zh: 因此這和我先前影片中的做法完全不同，因為它再次被完全重寫。

cues.en: It works.
cues.zh: 目前確實能夠使用。

cues.en: So if you're into offline models, this is probably a good way to go or go with Olama.
cues.zh: 如果你對離線模型有興趣，這應該是不錯的方向，或是也可以選擇 Ollama。

cues.en: They work more or less the same way in that they make a OpenAI client with a special URL.
cues.zh: 兩者運作方式大致相同，都是使用指定特殊 URL 的 OpenAI 用戶端。

cues.en: But that's everything there is to it.
cues.zh: 基本上就是這些。

cues.en: It's up to you if you feel like this is a good way of doing things.
cues.zh: 你可以自行判斷，這是不是適合自己的做法。

cues.en: If you want to go Olama or, like me, want to use the paid models up in the cloud.
cues.zh: 是要使用 Ollama，還是像我一樣，使用雲端的付費模型。

cues.en: But see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
